routine: C0/91AC-93E0 — acceleration / auto-target velocity integrator + subpixel->integer-pixel converter (the "$91AC step" in the C0/881E call order). m=1, x=1, DP=$1D00.
corrections: BLOCK 1 STRUCTURAL BUG (the only real defect): the spec puts `if (d[0x01]==0x03) { d[0x00]=2; d[0x01]=0; }` UNCONDITIONALLY after the whole Y block. In the ROM the `$01==3` arrival check at C0/91EC is reachable ONLY by fall-through from the Y-arrived-AND-settled path (91E2 BEQ, then 91E6 phase-zero, then 91E8 TSB $01,#$02, then falls into 91EC). Every OTHER Y path branches straight to 91F8: 91DA (Y moving +, $30=$10), 91E0 (Y moving -, $30=$F0), and 91E6 BNE (arrived but phase not settled -> 91DC sets $30=$F0 then BRA 91F8). So when Y is moving or unsettled the arrival check is SKIPPED. Divergence case: bit1 was set on an earlier frame and retained (because $01 was not yet 3 so 91F0 BNE skipped the clear), then on a later frame X arrives+settles (91CA TSB sets bit0 -> $01==3) while Y is now moving -> spec fires $00=2/$01=0, ROM does not. Fix: nest the $01==3 check INSIDE the Y-arrived-settled branch (i.e. only after `d[0x01] |= 0x02`).

COSMETIC: entryPoints/callsOut say 'JSR'd from C0/8855'. The `JSR $91AC` instruction is at C0/8852; C0/8855 is the RETURN address (it then `JSR $93E1`). Reword to 'JSR at C0/8852, returns to C0/8855 which enters the 93E1 tree'.

OPTIONAL CLARITY (not a behavior bug): block 4's `remainder` step in the spec recomputes sign tests from `a` (the original accumulator), which is correct, but note the ROM re-LDA's $3B (the accumulator) at 92E3/92E9 AFTER the pos/neg slot write — since the slot write never touches $3B this is equivalent; keep `a` = the pre-conversion accumulator value as the spec does.
crossChecks: Re-disassembled C0/91AC-93E1 independently (python tools/disasm_range.py C0 91AC 93E1 1 0 1D00). Confirmed every address, shift count (4x LSR), carry sense (CMP/BCC => A<mem), TSB/BIT semantics, and the 6 accumulator->slot STA targets ($3B->$42pos/$41neg, $3C->$44/$43, $3D->$46/$45, $3E->$48/$47, $3F->$4A/$49, $40->$4C/$4B) match the spec's table exactly.

boot_trace_play.txt (500003 lines): grepped the PC stream. 91AC is entered ~34 times; EVERY time 91AE BEQ->91F8 ($00==0) and 91FB BEQ->9238 ($01BC==0). Confirmed via set-of-seen-addresses that NO address in block 1 (91B0-91F6) or block 2 (91FD-9236) EVER executes in the whole trace -> block 1's bug never manifests on the field-walk fast path; only in auto-walk/forced-vector (cutscene) movement.

Trace also confirms the fast-path branch decisions inside blocks 3/4: 9254 BIT#$02->BEQ 926E ($36 bit1 clear, mirror path) and 9290 BIT#$04->BEQ 92AA ($36 bit2 clear) both fire; all six BMI tests (92CC/92F7/etc.) are NOT taken in the sampled frames and 92E7 BEQ (low nibble==0) is taken -> consistent with the converter math.
Recomputed block 2 magnitude/negate in Python: (c&4)<<2 and (c&2)<<3 both yield 0 or 0x10; EOR FF/INC == two's-complement -(mag) (0x10->0xF0). Matches spec.

Recomputed block 4 converter for {0x00,0x10,0x1F,0x7F,0x80,0xF0,0xF8,0xFF,0x08,0xF1}: pixels = |acc|>>4 (truncate toward zero), remainder = sign-extended low nibble. e.g. 0x80->neg=8/rem=0, 0xF8->rem=0xF8, 0x7F->pos=7/rem=0x0F. Matches spec exactly (truncation, not arithmetic floor).
Caller verified: C0/8852 = JSR $91AC, C0/8855 = JSR $93E1, then PLD/RTS — confirms outputs $41-$4C are consumed by the 93E1 step tree immediately after return.
